# Thornling
## Impact: 1

### Description:
Born from sun-scorched sand and hardened by the desert’s cruelty, Thornlings are resilient plantfolk covered in jagged spines.
### Active Abilities:

* Plant Body:
You are a cactus person, so you are basically a plant, meaning you get saturated by the sun.

* Piercing Thorns:
Your body is covered with sharp thorns.

### Passive Abilities:
* Short:
You are shorter then a regular human.

### Weaknesses:

* Frail:
You are weaker then a normal human. (8 hearts)

* Heavyload:
You cannot wear any heavy armor. (Armors heavier then iron cannot be worn.)

**This is a remastered version of the thornling from: [https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-plus-plus](https://modrinth.com/mod/origins-plus-plus)**
